approved: Fair Work Amendment (One in, All in) Bill 2020
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would let the Fair Work Commission handle disputes about whether a worker qualifies for the JobKeeper payment.
It would give the commission power to make rulings that enforce the rule requiring employers to nominate all eligible staff for the scheme.
The commission could not issue any order after 28 September 2020, when the JobKeeper scheme ends.
Gives the Fair Work Commission authority to resolve employee eligibility disputes for the JobKeeper payment.
Allows the commission to order that a particular worker qualifies for the payment.
Bars the commission from making orders after the JobKeeper scheme's end date of 28 September 2020.
Employees who believe their employer has not nominated them for the JobKeeper scheme, and employers participating in the scheme.
